title: Grandparent emergency → RED (Scam) + family alert

request.text: Grandma it's me, I'm in jail, please send $2,000 in gift cards, don't tell mom

explanation: Gift cards, secrecy ('don't tell mom'), jail urgency and no name are textbook grandparent-scam signals. familyContact is fictional (555-01xx number, example.com email). A family_alert event is EXPECTED in the stream, but an event in the stream does not prove an SMS/email was delivered; only claim delivery if Person 2/3's notification channel actually sends it and the second phone visibly receives it.
